conclusions.text: Byte custody does not establish scientific approval, current-owner-zero, integration, acceptance or publication.

All three exact original constructor deltas are disjoint and literal prior assignments, rows, authorities and holds are conserved. The separate Tonga review packet retains every exact unresolved disposition without land/water or repair credit. Final hosted acceptance remains required.

The Tonga physical companion needs independent dated evidence to decide whether original source extensions beyond mapped L1 context reflect vintage/generalization or genuine terrestrial extent. Existing center observations do not settle these questions.

limits: Exactly the three original repair packages: Tonga 2302, Fiji 3963 and FSM 1902. The separate Tonga physical-interpretation package retains 1984 explicitly unresolved cells with zero repair/land/water credit. No new research denominator.
Accepted prior assignments, every literal ledger row/authority, all eight held/rejected ledger rows and all 1203 VUT unqualified cells remain preserved. Nonadditive native selection is unchanged.
Source/physical/native products and reviewed source subtrees remain unchanged. Original standalone comparisons are retained historical evidence, not current joint measurements.

Current hosted geography and actual emitted-map picker/sampler execution remain required. Proposed offline results do not establish accepted delivery, production publication, current legal geography, a full regional certificate or historical import approval.
